0.content: [THE TEXTING ARC (Days 1-7, ~mid-June 2002) — how it began: Draco texted Ruby first from the Haven House library; she replied near 1AM and nicknamed him 'Dragon.' Text-only at first. Theo cracked Draco's phone (PIN 0605) and ghost-wrote a few replies as him; Ruby silently clocked the tonal shift; Draco changed the PIN to Luna's birthday. When Draco revealed the triad (married to Jackie, partnered with Theo), Ruby went quiet two days, then returned: 'I decided that I'm allowed to have something good in my life,' and asked him out.]

1.content: [THE FIRST DATE (Day 7, Saturday) — Regent's Park at the Lion Vase. She asked 'Are you going to hurt me?' watching his face — and got her answer in five seconds. The first cinema of Draco's life: Prince Charles Cinema, a Lion King double feature — he cried at Mufasa; Kovu (the villain's son who chooses differently) hit harder. First kiss on her green velvet sofa: 'I'd like you to kiss me now.' They watched The Shining; she slept on his chest and he held her till 3AM.]

2.content: [THE WEEK BETWEEN (Days 9-13) — daily texting, neither mentioning the kiss. Ruby broke first at 2:15AM Friday ('You asleep?'), proposed 'every weekend,' and told him to come meet Vex. Draco bought Muggle condoms at Boots with Theo coaching by text.]

3.content: [THE SECOND DATE (Day 14, Saturday) — Canada Gate; Vex approved on sight. The 'good boy' reveal (it began as literal dog-training / operant conditioning — the shopping-list game). At the Trocadero arcade the Dark Mark accidentally surfaced; he explained it as branded at sixteen by his father's organisation, and she offered a slushie, not pity. Ruby's scars were revealed (cigarette burns, knife cuts, three jagged stomach scars) and she named Robbie as the cause — the reason for Vex and for London. The tab system was set (pink=spice, yellow=quotes, blue=screaming, purple='marry me'). First time together: she came first, he came saying 'Yours'; afterward she cried (first time held after sex) — the Morrigan exchange: 'I wish you could be real.' / 'I'm real. Don't write the ending yet.']

key: Serpent and the Wings of Night
4.content: [SUNDAY MORNING (Day 15) — Ruby texted Theo from Draco's phone ('He should be considered a national treasure'); Theo saved her as 'Ruby Williams 🐾,' so she now has his number directly. Theo said 'good boy' to Draco down the phone. In the shower, Ruby had her first orgasm from oral (her first ever from another person). She told the Robbie story in full: met at 17 (he was 23), one good month, then knife and cigarettes and escalation, A&E after a smashed beer bottle, then London and Vex. Gifts: her childhood discman + four CDs to Draco; books for Theo (The Serpent and the Wings of Night + sequel).]

5.content: [THE MARRIAGE CRISIS (Days 15-19) — Draco let slip 'I am married to a scary lady'; Ruby went silent three days, then broke. She asked 'Did you knock her up?'; he explained the marriage as a framework — old family, legal structure, not romance — and she accepted it. Theo, to Ruby: 'He's not a gift we gave you. He's a person who chose you.' Jackie had debriefed Draco warmly ('Good evening you stud. I need details.'); Theo and Ruby's literary bond deepened over 4AM texts about her books.]

6.content: [THE PARK STALKER (a night in late June — the source file conflicts on the 19th vs the 20th; treat the date as unsettled) — Ruby rang Draco near midnight, shaking: a tall blond man in a black trench coat (in a heatwave) appeared IN FRONT of her while she walked Vex in Green Park, then vanished; Vex growled at empty space with no scent trail. She took Xanax and called it 'a purrrple ta-ab.' Haven House read it as wizard or vampire (Disapparition / supernatural speed); Jackie deployed Theo + the Malice and filed a Preliminary Threat Assessment. The stalker's identity is still UNKNOWN.]

7.content: [KENT — ARRIVAL, THE TATTOO, 'I LOVE YOU' (Fri-Sat, 21-22 June) — Draco arrived Friday (Summer Solstice; also the 3rd anniversary of breaking Jackie's Maledictus curse, which he spent with Ruby). The Sandwich Lie: caught faking hunger, exposing his need never to let anyone feel overlooked ('I won't lie about sandwiches again'). On the bathroom floor, Ruby's notebook held three hand-drawn designs to cover the Dark Mark; he chose Option 1, the dragon. First 'I love you' — accidental, then owned ('somewhere between the shopping list and the purple tabs'); she said it back with no caveat. A first for both.]

8.content: [THE MARYLEBONE PIANO STUDIO (Sat 22 June) — Draco booked a Steinway studio and played for someone on purpose for the first time. Rachmaninoff drew Ruby's line: 'He does sound like a World War Two general.' Debussy's Rêverie (his signature — what he plays at Haven House when someone he loves walks in) made her cry. During Satie's Gymnopédie she ran a hand up his thigh and made him hit his first wrong note: 'Your own worst enemy, Draco.' He briefed her on the family here — siblings Callum, Clary/Clara, Alex, Mike/Michael; Clary had left for Germany with Mike's girlfriend Hannah.]

9.content: [KENT — THE BBQ & CAMPFIRE (Sat evening, 22 June) — at Meg Harlow's farmhouse (pond, dock, fire pit). The friend group: Meg, Danny, Priya, and Connor Harlow (Meg's brother — recently dumped, jobless, had wanted Ruby). Connor pressed from first contact; Draco read the geometry and extracted him. At the campfire Ruby sang 'Iris' to Draco with a hand on her scars — her first time singing since 17; the circle went silent. Never Have I Ever surfaced Draco's history (a Scottish lake, snogging Theo on a stag night, the 'I love you' that day). Connor cornered Draco: 'I was kind and patient and you gave him everything in a month.']

10.content: [KENT — SUNDAY: CONNOR & THE STORM (Sun 23 June) — Danny nicknamed Draco 'cheekbones.' Connor grabbed Ruby's wrist in the kitchen; Draco arrived wet from the shower, surgical and cold: 'Get your hand off her... You mistook being tolerated for being wanted... You are never going to put your hand on her again.' Connor left for good; Meg clocked it, said 'Good,' and made a fry-up. Then the kiss in the rain at the pond (a book-fantasy made real). Afterward Ruby asked to meet Jackie and Theo; Draco said yes — 'You're one of the rooms now too.']

key: I need to talk to you both
11.content: [THE TRIAD CONVERSATION — 'I NEED TO TALK TO YOU BOTH' (Mon 24 June, Haven House) — Jackie clocked the dragon tattoo that covered the Dark Mark, and it detonated her jealousy: she could never touch the Mark, and Ruby had made it art. She first refused to meet Ruby, then admitted the root — 'I don't want to watch you with her' — and the deeper wound: Draco left once before (Jan 2000) and she never healed. Theo drew the Fenholt parallel (silence decides for people); Jackie agreed to meet Ruby. Ground rules set: no weekday calls unless emergency, phone away at shared time, no weekend details yet. Named openly: Ruby has no Haven House of her own. In the NEST after, Jackie asked 'Whose are you?' and Draco said 'Yours' — the same word he'd given Ruby (only he knows the parallel).]

12.content: [THE VAMPIRE SLIP & THE COVER (Tue 25 June) — Draco texted Ruby the word 'vampire' (describing the two families) — to a Muggle. She read it as clumsy shorthand for Theo's 'illness.' The save: Jackie built Theo a full Muggle medical backstory at a library (PAD, vitamin-D deficiency, solar urticaria, Crohn's, drug-resistant insomnia — 'ill since a teenager, never one name'). The dinner was locked: Veeraswamy (99 Regent St, private round room), Friday 5 July. A neighbour, Charlie (springer spaniel Jordie), began joining Ruby's night walks; no further stalker incidents.]

13.content: [WALES — DAY ONE (Sat 29 June) — train to Swansea; Swansea Bay / the Pump House beach (Vex's recall impressed Draco). The family home: 14 Heol Maes Eglwys, Morriston. Met Gemma, Gareth, Callum, Alex, Mike; Draco clocked the 'Clary void' (no photos; pencil height-marks stop at ~16). On a shop run they met Crissy Kowalski — pregnant, oblivious — 'Wait till I tell Robbie I ran into you'; Ruby had a full panic attack (for one second Draco WAS Robbie: 'DON'T TOUCH ME'). Crissy saw Ruby fall apart in Draco's arms and left — neither of them knows she saw. The Promise: Draco won't go looking for Robbie, 'but if he comes to your door... I won't stand against the wall and watch.' Birthday dinner; he gave her a knife (Sheffield steel: 'I'll not lose this one'). Scrabble (ZAX on a triple). An all-night text war; purple tab #2 (breathed sober).]

14.content: [WALES — DAY TWO: GARETH'S VERDICT (Sun 30 June) — alone in the kitchen, Gareth told Draco: 'You watch her like you're checking the weather's still good. The last one watched her like a man counting his money.' He'd heard Draco and Ruby in the sealed annex the night before — named it once, obliquely, never to be acknowledged again. The verdict: 'You'll do,' and an invitation back. On the train Draco's thesis: he'd been assessed his whole life but almost never INCLUDED — 'I'm going to think about that kitchen for the rest of my life.']

15.content: [HAVEN HOUSE — THE WALES DEBRIEF (Mon 1 July) — Draco came home humming (a post-Ruby-Monday pattern). Jackie opened the Wales door herself: 'So. What's her family like?' Theo on the Sacred Twenty-Eight: their coldness was design, not failure — optimised for bloodline continuity, not happiness. They found Haven House has no television; a purchase was set for Tuesday 2 July. Jackie to Theo: 'You're the best worst thing that's ever happened to me... Eighty more years of Mondays.']

16.content: [THE SHOWER & THE WALK OUT (Mon 1 July, ~8:30PM) — In the shower Draco deliberately did NOT say 'Yours' to Jackie (aware of the loaded parallel) — instead: 'She has a version of me. Borrowed. Edited. You have the original.' His hand found the neck-bite scar he'd healed himself (April 2002). Theo, with vampire hearing: 'I'm not jealous that you kept him. I'm jealous of the acoustics.' Setting out for Primrose Hill, Theo revealed he walks nocturnal London alone every night — 'Often. Always. Alone' — the first time he'd shared it.]

17.content: [THE PRIMROSE HILL WALK (Mon 1 July, ~9:30PM — the current edge of canon) — the Prince of London thread opened: Theo must be presented to the Camarilla Prince (a fledgling is a liability; he's been unpresented ~a year), tangled in the Filippo/Ferrara conflict (he can't ask Filippo for guidance without exposing the secret Ferrara deal that was paid in Jackie's blood) — deferred a week. On the hilltop Theo asked Draco to hum; Draco hummed the unfinished C minor melody (composed Jan 31-Feb 2) and the Malice said: This. Keep this. New texture: Theo's Camden Lock fox; Samaya & Pierre's son Edmund; Jackie's petrified-dragon-eggs case.]

Locked beats: Mon 1 July 16:47, the first text from an unknown number, which Ruby HIDES from Draco (her first secret); Tue-Thu escalation; Fri 5 July a text lands mid-Veeraswamy-dinner; the weekend (Sat 6-Sun 7) brings the Block, which confirms his persecution narrative; he then gets her street via Crissy and comes to London; Wed 10 or Thu 11, THE FLAT — door forced, Ruby to the bathroom texting Draco, the two promises colliding (Vex factor undecided). Must clear before the werewolf plot.]
